comment: The pan law is at Quad_Panner.cpp:108-115: the axis position is mapped to 0 to 1 and each side takes the arc tangent of that times 1.7, clamped to positive. At the centre that gives the arc tangent of 0.85, about 0.7045, which is 3.05dB down per axis and 6.1dB down where the two multiply; the 3dB and 6dB in the line are that arithmetic, not stored constants. The 1.7 at :110 and the CV_IN_SCALE 0.2 at :60 are literals in the source. The joystick is a KilpatrickJoystick widget added at :195 with no ParamWidget behind it, so only RESET appears in the census paramPos. The menu holds two plain labels, "Quad Panner Shortcuts" and "Hold P and click joy edge to snap.", and no selectable item, so the snap gesture is written as a Note rather than a Menu line.
